The test image shows a mango leaf with irregular brown/dark lesions on the upper surface. The spots appear irregular in shape, somewhat sunken/flat, dark brown, scattered across the leaf surface. No white powdery coating, no black sooty encrustation, no stem dieback visible.

This points strongly to Anthracnose — irregular brown spots on leaf surface. Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image shows a severely yellowed/damaged leaf at an advanced stage, different appearance but within the Anthracnose class spectrum. The test image shows a green leaf with irregular dark brown spots — matching the Anthracnose description: "oval or irregular brown to deep brown sunken spots on leaves." No white powder (Powdery Mildew), no black sooty coating (Sooty Mould), no twig/stem symptoms (Die Back).
